existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decline in population trajectory describes the same negative population-level demographic outcome as decreased population size and trajectory already in this group.
Increase in cell death is effectively synonymous with increased apoptosis/general cell death described by the other members of this merge group.
Increased DNA damage and mutation describes the same directional increase in DNA damage as the other members of this merge group.
Impaired ovulation describes the same decreased/impaired ovulation outcome as the other members of this merge group.
Disruption of neural crest cell migration describes the same process as reduced neural crest cell migration already in this similar_event_different_biological_context group.
Decrease in mitochondrial membrane potential is a core indicator of mitochondrial dysfunction, closely synonymous with the mitochondrial disruption events in this merge group.
Decreased viable offspring describes a reduced reproductive success outcome closely related to the fecundity/reproductive success events already in this group.
Decrease in egg production and cumulative fecundity describes the same directional decrease in fecundity as the other members of this similar_event_different_biological_context group.
Decrease in cell growth describes the same directional reduction in growth as the other members of this merge group.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe chemical modification of proteins — one by interaction of α-diketones with arginine residues and the other by oxidation/denaturation of membrane proteins — involving protein damage by reactive compounds but through distinct chemical processes on different protein substrates.

Both describe pulmonary pathological outcomes but bronchiolitis obliterans is an airway fibrotic/inflammatory disease while lung cancer is a neoplastic outcome — same organ but distinct disease processes.
Increased muscarinic acetylcholine receptors and chronic kidney disease are not the same object — withdrawing; these are not appropriately grouped.

Reduced progesterone uptake/decreased maturation and reduction in progesterone synthesis both describe decreased progesterone availability but one specifies uptake/maturation context and the other specifies synthesis.

LH receptor antagonism and reduction in gonadotropins/LH both involve LH signaling but one describes receptor-level antagonism and the other describes circulating hormone reduction — distinct processes sharing the same hormonal axis.

Reduced tidal volume and increased incidence of respiratory disease/dysfunction both describe adverse respiratory outcomes but one is a specific physiological measurement and the other is a broader disease outcome.

Inhibition of TBX1 and impairment of fourth pharyngeal arch development are causally related — TBX1 is a transcription factor critical for pharyngeal arch development — but enzyme/factor inhibition and organ-level developmental impairment are distinct processes.

Maturation of TNF/iNOS-producing dendritic cells and dendritic cell activation both describe dendritic cell functional activation but one specifies a TNF/iNOS-producing subset and the other is general dendritic cell activation.

Increased IL-23 from dendritic cells, Th17 cell migration and inflammation induction, and psoriatic skin disease are sequential steps in the same IL-23/Th17 inflammatory pathway leading to psoriasis but represent distinct biological processes at different levels.

Increased anti-DNA antibody from autoreactive B cells and exacerbation of systemic lupus erythematosus are causally related events — antibody production is upstream of SLE exacerbation — but are distinct biological processes.
Binding to estrogen receptor alpha in immune cells and agonism of the estrogen receptor both describe ER activation but one specifies immune cell context while the other is general.

Inhibition of JAK3 and impairment of T-cell dependent antibody response are causally linked — JAK3 inhibition impairs lymphocyte signaling leading to diminished antibody responses — but represent distinct molecular vs. immunological processes.

Trypsin inhibition, increased intestinal monitor peptide, increased blood CCK, and increased exocrine pancreatic secretion are sequential events in the same trypsin inhibitor/CCK feedback pathway but represent distinct biological processes at different levels.

Interferon-I antiviral response antagonized by SARS-CoV-2 and increased SARS-CoV-2 production are causally related — suppression of antiviral response facilitates viral production — but represent distinct biological processes.
Altered photoreceptor patterning and altered visual function describe the same sensory system at different levels — cellular/structural (photoreceptor) vs. functional/organismal (visual function).

Abnormal osmoregulation and body fluid overload are causally related — impaired osmoregulation leads to fluid overload — but represent distinct processes: a physiological regulatory failure vs. its fluid balance consequence.

Oxidation of glutathione and depletion of glutathione both involve the same molecule (GSH) but oxidation is a chemical modification process while depletion describes overall loss of available GSH — distinct processes on the same object.

Impaired anterior-posterior axis development and reduced neural crest cell migration both describe developmental defects but one is a body-axis patterning process and the other is a cell migration event — related developmental context but distinct processes.

Increased protein oxidation and oxidation/denaturation of membrane proteins both describe oxidative damage to proteins, with the latter specifying membrane-associated proteins — these are effectively the same oxidative protein damage event at different levels of specificity.

Induced dysfunction of microcirculation and vascular insufficiency both describe vascular functional impairment but one specifies the microcirculation compartment while the other is broader vascular insufficiency.

Frustrated phagocytosis and inflammatory events in light-exposed tissues both describe inflammatory/immune processes but in distinct biological contexts — frustrated phagocytosis is a cellular immune mechanism while the other specifies light-exposed tissue inflammation.

Inhibition of cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS) and increased homocysteine/plasma HCY levels are causally linked — CBS inhibition prevents homocysteine catabolism leading to its accumulation — but represent enzyme inhibition vs. metabolite accumulation, which are distinct processes.

Impaired coordination and movement and neuronal dysfunction both describe neurological functional impairment but one specifies a motor/behavioral outcome while the other describes cellular neuronal dysfunction.

Induction of GATA3 expression and increase of Th2 cells producing IL-4 are causally sequential — GATA3 is the master transcription factor driving Th2 differentiation — but gene expression induction and cellular differentiation/cytokine production are distinct biological processes.

Mitochondrial ATP synthase antagonism and decrease in mitochondrial membrane potential both describe mitochondrial functional impairment but antagonism of a specific complex and loss of membrane potential are distinct processes on overlapping but not identical biological objects.
Inhibition of N-linked glycosylation and accumulation of misfolded proteins are causally linked — impaired glycosylation leads to protein misfolding — but represent distinct molecular processes.
